from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u064/system/state/workspace/programs/task-ef15ba70.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    points = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0]

    # The colored marks lie on parallel diagonals. Their invariant (c-r or c+r)
    # gives the phase of a repeating color pattern.
    best = None
    for orientation in (0, 1):
        groups = {}
        for r, c, color in points:
            phase = c-r if orientation == 0 else c+r
            groups.setdefault(phase, set()).add(color)
        good = {phase: next(iter(colors)) for phase, colors in groups.items() if len(colors) == 1}
        support = sum(sum(1 for r, c, col in points
                          if (c-r if orientation == 0 else c+r) == phase)
                      for phase in good)
        score = (support, len(good))
        if best is None or score > best[0]:
            best = (score, orientation, good)
    _, orientation, phases = best
    period = len(phases)
    residues = {(phase % period): color for phase, color in phases.items()}
    if period and len(residues) == period:
        out = []
        for r in range(h):
            row = []
            for c in range(w):
                phase = c-r if orientation == 0 else c+r
                row.append(residues[phase % period])
            out.append(row)
        return out

    # For horizontal bands, extend the sequence of nonblank band colors cyclically.
    band_colors = [(r, grid[r][0]) for r in range(h)
                   if all(v == grid[r][0] for v in grid[r]) and grid[r][0] != 0]
    if band_colors:
        first = band_colors[0][0]
        seq = [color for _, color in band_colors]
        out = []
        for r in range(h):
            if all(v == 0 for v in grid[r]):
                color = seq[(r-first) % len(seq)]
                out.append([color] * w)
            else:
                out.append(list(grid[r]))
        return out
    return [list(row) for row in grid]
'''
